t: This is Clapham South tube station, on the Morden branch of the Northern line, between Clapham Common and Balham. It stands at the corner of Balham Hill and Nightingale Lane, on the southern edge of Clapham Common, in fare zones 2 and 3. It was designed by Charles Holden, an English architect best known for designing many London Underground stations in the 1920s and 1930s. He also designed the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway and the University of London's Senate House.
